agents.description: Copilot SDK agent running in the local agent host process
Claude agent backed by the Anthropic Claude Agent SDK
Codex agent using session-selected model providers

http.proxy.title: HTTP Proxy
http.proxy.description: The proxy URL used by network requests from the Agent Host.

http.proxyKerberosServicePrincipal.title: HTTP Proxy Kerberos Service Principal
http.proxyKerberosServicePrincipal.description: The Kerberos service principal used to authenticate with the HTTP proxy.

http.noProxy.title: HTTP No Proxy
http.noProxy.description: Domain names that bypass the configured HTTP proxy.

http.proxySupport.title: HTTP Proxy Support
http.proxySupport.description: Controls whether network requests from the Agent Host use the resolved proxy.
enumDescriptions: Disable proxy support.
Enable proxy support.
Enable proxy support, falling back to request options when no proxy is found.
Enable proxy support, overriding request options.

http.systemCertificates.title: HTTP System Certificates
http.systemCertificates.description: Whether network requests from the Agent Host trust CA certificates loaded from the OS.

http.systemCertificatesNode.title: HTTP System Certificates Node
http.systemCertificatesNode.description: Whether the Agent Host loads system certificates using Node.js built-in support.

missionControlUseLocalCredentials.title: Use Local Credentials
missionControlUseLocalCredentials.description: Use this host's GitHub and Copilot credentials for same-account Mission Control sessions.

ahpJsonlLoggingEnabled.title: AHP Transport Logging
ahpJsonlLoggingEnabled.description: Capture Mission Control AHP transport messages on the host.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: Permission rules: a tool name or Tool(specifier), e.g. Shell(npm run *), WebFetch(example.com), WebFetch(example.com/docs/*), Read(./src/**), Edit(./docs/**), Mcp(server), or Mcp(server/tool). Shell specifiers support wildcards, /regex/flags, and commandLine:<specifier> for the full command line. Deny rules reject matching calls; ask rules require confirmation before allow rules or implicit defaults. Updated automatically when approving "in this Session" or "Always Allow".

disableRepoInfoTelemetry.title: Disable Repository Information Telemetry
disableRepoInfoTelemetry.description: Whether repository information telemetry is disabled for Agent Host sessions.

telemetryLevel.title: Telemetry Level
telemetryLevel.description: Most restrictive telemetry level requested by connected clients.

editTelemetryEnabled.title: Edit Telemetry
editTelemetryEnabled.description: Whether edit attribution telemetry is enabled for Agent Host sessions.

byokModelsEnabled.title: BYOK Models
byokModelsEnabled.description: Whether extension-provided BYOK models are enabled.

utilitySmallModel.title: Utility Model
utilitySmallModel.description: The `vendor/id` of a BYOK model that overrides the default model for utility flows such as title and pull request generation. Empty uses the default behavior.

byokUtilityModelDefault.title: BYOK Utility Model Default
byokUtilityModelDefault.description: The default model for utility flows when the chat's selected main agent model is a BYOK model. A configured utility model takes precedence.
enumDescriptions: Do not use a default utility model.
Use the selected BYOK main agent model.
Use the default GitHub Copilot utility model.

codexAgentEnabled.title: Codex Agent
codexAgentEnabled.description: Whether the Codex provider is enabled.

terminalAutoApproveEnabled.title: Terminal Auto Approve
terminalAutoApproveEnabled.description: Whether terminal auto-approve rules forwarded by the connected client are allowed to apply to agent-host shell permission requests.

globalAutoApproveEnabled.title: Global Auto Approve
globalAutoApproveEnabled.description: Whether VS Code's global auto-approve setting is enabled. When `true`, every tool call is auto-approved, equivalent to a session using Allow all.

assistedApprovalInstructions.title: Assisted Permissions Instructions
assistedApprovalInstructions.description: User-authored instructions for the reviewer that decides which tool calls run without confirmation under Assisted permissions. Empty uses the default guidance.

hooksEnabled.title: Hooks
hooksEnabled.description: Whether VS Code's `chat.useHooks` setting allows hooks. When `false`, Copilot sessions run no repository hooks, custom agent hooks, or plugin hooks that VS Code runs itself.

autoReplyEnabled.title: Auto Reply
autoReplyEnabled.description: Whether VS Code's auto-reply setting is enabled. When `true`, `ask_user` questions are auto-answered instead of blocking on the user, mirroring autopilot mode.

systemProxyEnabled.title: System Proxy Discovery
systemProxyEnabled.description: Whether Copilot sessions automatically discover and use the operating system's proxy configuration.

githubMcpServerEnabled.title: GitHub MCP Server
githubMcpServerEnabled.description: Whether agent sessions include a GitHub MCP server by default.

computerUseEnabled.title: Computer Use
computerUseEnabled.description: Whether local Copilot agent sessions on macOS and Windows offer GitHub's Computer Use plugin.

browserUseEnabled.title: Browser Use
browserUseEnabled.description: Whether local Copilot agent sessions offer GitHub's Browser Use plugin.

mcpToolRoutingEnabled.title: MCP Tool Routing
mcpToolRoutingEnabled.description: Whether Copilot agent sessions use cached MCP tool metadata for routing.

mcpGalleryServiceUrl.title: MCP Gallery Service URL
mcpGalleryServiceUrl.description: The MCP Gallery service URL configured in VS Code. The agent host downloads MCP server details for installation from this gallery itself, including when it is on a private network. Empty when no gallery is configured.

mcpSamplingAllowedServers.title: MCP Sampling Allowed Servers
mcpSamplingAllowedServers.description: MCP server identities whose sampling requests are automatically approved in all sessions on this agent host. Approvals include known configuration and source identity, or the exact server name when no other identity is available. Remove an entry to require confirmation again. This does not approve its tool calls.

mcpSkillsServerApprovals.title: MCP Skills Server Approvals
mcpSkillsServerApprovals.description: Per-server-identity decisions for loading and using MCP-served skills in all sessions on this agent host. Identities include known server configuration and source, or the exact server name when no other identity is available. Remove an entry to ask again. This does not approve ordinary tool permission requests.

extensionPermissionApprovals.title: Extension Permission Approvals
extensionPermissionApprovals.description: Per-extension-identity decisions for letting Copilot extensions load with privileged capabilities, such as registering hooks, or read sensitive environment variables, in all sessions on this agent host. Identities include the extension name and the requested capabilities or variable names. Decisions about a project's extensions to read sensitive environment variables are never stored. Remove an entry to ask again.

activeAgentTitleGeneration.title: Active Agent Title Generation
activeAgentTitleGeneration.description: Whether the active agent names sessions and chats with rename tools instead of immediate utility-model title generation. Deferred title generation takes precedence. Changes apply to new sessions.

deferredTitleGeneration.title: Deferred Title Generation
deferredTitleGeneration.description: Seed titles immediately and refine them in the background if the first response turn completes successfully, without asking the active agent to name chats. Explicit rename tools remain available. Overrides active agent title generation for new sessions; existing sessions and their chats retain their strategy.

titleGeneration.title: Title Generation
titleGeneration.description: Controls how new sessions and chats get an automatic title. Takes precedence over the legacy active agent and deferred title generation keys. Changes apply to new sessions; existing sessions and their chats retain their strategy.
enumDescriptions: A utility model generates titles immediately.
The active agent names sessions and chats with rename tools.

Seed titles immediately, refine them in the background after the first response turn completes successfully, and remind the active agent that it may rename a chat when the generated title is inaccurate or no longer reflects the user's goal.

mcpConnectorsEnabled.title: Copilot Connectors
mcpConnectorsEnabled.description: Whether Copilot agent sessions expose MCP servers provided by connected Copilot Connectors.

mcpSkillsEnabled.title: MCP Skills
mcpSkillsEnabled.description: Whether Copilot agent sessions discover and use skills served by MCP servers. Changes apply to new sessions.

markdownPlanRichLinksEnabled.title: Markdown Plan Rich Links
markdownPlanRichLinksEnabled.description: Whether agents receive guidance for using rich links and running task markers in Markdown plan documents.

workspaceSnapshotEnabled.title: Initial Workspace Snapshot
workspaceSnapshotEnabled.description: Whether the first turn of a new Copilot chat includes a bounded file-name snapshot of its working directories.

agentOrchestrationLimits.title: Agent Orchestration Limits
agentOrchestrationLimits.description: Controls creation, messaging, and recursion safety limits for Agent Host session tools.
enumDescriptions: Enforce agent orchestration safety limits.
Do not enforce agent orchestration safety limits.

sessionModelOptions.title: Session Model Options
sessionModelOptions.description: Controls whether agents can choose a model's reasoning effort and context size in `create_session`, and how they find the models and options.
enumDescriptions: Agents choose only a model in `create_session`.
Agents can also choose a reasoning effort and context size, and `create_session` lists the models and their options when the agent loads it through tool search.
Agents can also choose a reasoning effort and context size, and list the models and their options with `list_models`.

artifactTools.title: Artifact Tools
artifactTools.description: Whether agents can record artifacts — pull requests, issues, commits, websites, files and other resources — with the artifact tools.

chatResources.title: Chat Resources
chatResources.description: Whether agents can choose how the chat shows the files they record, such as above the chat input.

artifactIntegrations.title: Artifact Integrations
artifactIntegrations.description: Enables live artifact state, actions, and opt-in automation instead of Agent Merge. Saved automation choices are preserved when switching.

githubArtifactMarkReadyIgnoredChecks.title: Checks Excluded from Automatic Mark Ready
githubArtifactMarkReadyIgnoredChecks.description: Check-name patterns that do not need to pass before a pull request artifact is automatically marked ready.

canvasesEnabled.title: Canvases
canvasesEnabled.description: Whether Copilot sessions can use Canvas extensions to present interactive content.

autoAttachPullRequests.title: Automatic Pull Request Association
autoAttachPullRequests.description: Whether the Agent Host automatically discovers and associates a pull request for the currently checked-out branch. When disabled, only pull requests recorded as artifacts or explicitly associated by session actions are considered.

modelRouter.enabled.title: Model Routers
modelRouter.enabled.description: Whether model routers from ~/.agents/model-routers are offered as Copilot models.

overlapProviderPreparation.title: Overlap Provider Preparation
overlapProviderPreparation.description: Whether agents prepare their session for a turn while the turn-start checkpoint is captured, instead of after it.

prewarmSessions.title: Prewarm Sessions
prewarmSessions.description: Whether new Copilot chats start their runtime and MCP servers before the first message.

enumDescriptions: Allow idle sleep while a chat is working.
Prevent idle sleep while a chat is working, even on battery power.
Prevent idle sleep only while the host is plugged in. On Linux desktop, the power source is unavailable, so this option allows idle sleep.
keepAwakeWhileWorking.title: Keep Awake While Working
keepAwakeWhileWorking.description: Controls when this Agent Host prevents idle sleep while a chat is working. The display can turn off and explicit sleep is not inhibited.

showExternalSessions.title: Show External Agent Sessions
showExternalSessions.description: Controls whether sessions created outside the Agent Host are included in the session catalog.
enumDescriptions: Do not show external sessions.
Show the 2 most recently updated external sessions from the last 7 days, hiding any that are older than your 2 newest local sessions.
Show external sessions updated in the last 24 hours.
Show external sessions updated in the last 7 days.
Show external sessions updated in the last 30 days.

autoArchiveMergedSessionsAfterDays.title: Auto-Archive Merged Sessions
autoArchiveMergedSessionsAfterDays.description: Number of inactive days after which a session with a merged pull request is automatically archived. Zero disables automatic archival.

autoDeleteArchivedMergedSessionsAfterDay.title: Auto-Delete Archived Merged Sessions
autoDeleteArchivedMergedSessionsAfterDay.description: Number of days after automatic archival before a session with a merged pull request is permanently deleted. Zero disables permanent deletion.

editAutoApprovePatterns.title: Edit Auto Approve Patterns
editAutoApprovePatterns.description: Effective edit auto-approve patterns forwarded by the connected client for agent-host write permission checks.

terminalIgnoreDefaultAutoApproveRules.title: Ignore Default Terminal Auto Approve Rules
terminalIgnoreDefaultAutoApproveRules.description: Ignore implicit terminal auto-approve rules and use only explicit permission rules.

mcpServers.title: MCP Servers
mcpServers.description: Agent-host-level MCP servers exposed to every session, keyed by server name. Each value is a server configuration (see `<serverName>`).

<serverName>.title: MCP Server
<serverName>.description: A single MCP server entry. The property key is the server name.

type.title: Server Type
type.description: The transport used to reach the server: `stdio` for a local command, `http` for a remote endpoint.

command.title: Command
command.description: For `stdio` servers, the executable to spawn.

args.title: Arguments
args.description: For `stdio` servers, the arguments passed to the command.

env.title: Environment
env.description: For `stdio` servers, environment variables set on the spawned process.

cwd.title: Working Directory
cwd.description: For `stdio` servers, the working directory the command runs in.

url.title: URL
url.description: For `http` servers, the endpoint URL of the MCP server.

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: For `http` servers, HTTP headers sent with every request.

customizations.title: Plugins
customizations.description: Plugins configured on this agent host and available to remote sessions.

defaultShell.title: Default Shell
defaultShell.description: Absolute path to the shell executable used by host-managed terminals. Normally pushed by the connected VS Code client from `terminal.integrated.agentHostProfile.<os>` (falling back to `terminal.integrated.defaultProfile.<os>`); when unset, the agent host falls back to the system shell. Only the path is supported; `args` and `env` from the workbench profile are not piped through yet. The workbench only pushes this for the local agent host — remote agent host operators should set this directly in the remote machine's `agent-host-config.json`.

githubEnterpriseUri.title: GitHub Enterprise URI
githubEnterpriseUri.description: Optional base URI of a GitHub Enterprise instance (for example "https://ghe.example.com" for GitHub Enterprise Server, or "https://tenant.ghe.com" for GitHub Enterprise Cloud). When set, the agent host authenticates and makes GitHub API calls against this instance instead of github.com. Normally pushed by the connected VS Code client from the selected enterprise account's authorization server; remote agent host operators can set it directly in the remote `agent-host-config.json`.

envVars.title: Environment Variables
envVars.description: Maps environment variable names to objects with an injectHosts array of HTTPS destinations. Destination patterns are validated by the runtime.

envVars.title: Environment Variables
envVars.description: Maps environment variable names to objects with an injectHosts array of HTTPS destinations. Destination patterns are validated by the runtime.

imageGeneration.title: Image Generation
imageGeneration.description: Enable image generation and editing when the runtime's image model is available to your account. Prompts and selected images are sent to that model, and its charges are in addition to the conversation model. Account access and tool permissions still apply. Disabling this setting prevents future image tool calls.

imageGenerationWatermark.title: Image Watermark
imageGenerationWatermark.description: Request a visible "Made with AI" label on images generated or edited by Copilot. Applies to new and existing Copilot sessions without enabling image generation. Labels are generated by the image model and are not guaranteed. Turning this off does not remove existing labels from input images.

enableCustomTerminalTool.title: Use Agent Host Terminal Tool
enableCustomTerminalTool.description: When enabled, Copilot SDK sessions use Agent Host's terminal tool override instead of the SDK's default terminal behavior. Not supported on Windows, where sessions use the SDK's terminal and sandbox runtime.

enableShellInitScript.title: Shell Init Script
enableShellInitScript.description: When enabled, Copilot SDK sessions apply the shell init script published by the client before each shell command.

copilotSdkLogLevel.title: Copilot SDK Log Level
copilotSdkLogLevel.description: Controls logging from the Copilot SDK runtime. Agent host trace logging always enables trace output.

runtimePath.title: Copilot Runtime Path
runtimePath.description: Absolute path to a local Copilot runtime executable. Empty uses the bundled runtime.

policyHelper.title: Copilot Policy Helper
policyHelper.description: Policy helper executable for the Copilot runtime. Device and server policies take precedence. An empty path disables it. Changes restart the runtime after active turns and subagents finish.

path.title: Path
path.description: Absolute path to the policy helper executable.

args.title: Arguments
args.description: Arguments passed to the policy helper executable.

m365Enabled.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot
m365Enabled.description: Requested enablement of Microsoft 365 Copilot access and account choice for Copilot Agent Host sessions. Requires restarting VS Code; changing this value must not switch an active account or service.

rubberDuck.title: Rubber Duck Agent
rubberDuck.description: When enabled, the coding agent uses a rubber duck critic subagent to review code changes using a complementary model.

claudeAdvisor.title: Claude Advisor Tool
claudeAdvisor.description: When enabled, Copilot SDK sessions using supported Claude models expose the provider-native Advisor tool.

searchSubagent.title: Search Subagent
searchSubagent.description: When enabled, Copilot SDK sessions are offered the runtime's search subagent tool for codebase search. Applied when a session launches or resumes.

searchSubagentGrepNudge.title: Search Subagent Grep Nudge
searchSubagentGrepNudge.description: During the first two user messages, defer at most one grep search per message to suggest the available search subagent. Further grep calls proceed through normal permissions. Does not affect searches inside subagents.

searchSubagentModel.title: Search Subagent Model
searchSubagentModel.description: CAPI model ID to use for the search subagent. Empty uses the runtime default. An unavailable model makes the search tool unavailable. Changing this value restarts the Copilot SDK client after active turns finish.

exploreAgent.title: Explore Agent
exploreAgent.description: When enabled, Copilot SDK sessions can use the runtime's built-in Explore agent, independently of the search subagent tool. Applied when a session launches or resumes. Does not disable custom agents named Explore.

executionSubagent.title: Runtime Execution Subagent
executionSubagent.description: Opt into the Copilot runtime execution subagent in Copilot Agent Host sessions. Runtime experiment assignments may override this default. When available, the runtime implementation replaces the extension-native execution tool. Changing this setting restarts the Copilot runtime after active turns finish.

executionSubagentModel.title: Runtime Execution Subagent Model
executionSubagentModel.description: Default model ID for the Copilot runtime execution subagent. Empty inherits the session model. Runtime experiment assignments may override this default. Changing this setting restarts the Copilot runtime after active turns finish.

executionSubagentDefaultControlled.title: Runtime Execution Subagent Default Control
executionSubagentDefaultControlled.description: Whether the workbench execution subagent enablement setting has no explicit override. Used only to gate setting experiment telemetry.

executionSubagentModelDefaultControlled.title: Runtime Execution Subagent Model Default Control
executionSubagentModelDefaultControlled.description: Whether the workbench execution subagent model setting has no explicit override. Used only to gate setting experiment telemetry.

localIndexEnabled.title: Local Session Index
localIndexEnabled.description: Whether Copilot SDK sessions use the local cross-session store for Chronicle indexing and retrieval.

opus48Prompt.title: Opus 4.8 Agent Prompt
opus48Prompt.description: When enabled, Copilot SDK sessions running a Claude Opus 4.8 model apply Opus 4.8-tuned system-prompt section overrides on top of the default system message.

stabilityOrderedPrompt.title: Stability-Ordered System Prompt
stabilityOrderedPrompt.description: When enabled, Copilot SDK sessions order the system prompt by how often each section changes, so sessions with the same tools and workspace can reuse each other's prompt cache. This moves per-session sections, such as the environment and session folder, to the end of the system prompt.

securityReviewSecretDetection.title: Security Review Secret Detection
securityReviewSecretDetection.description: When enabled, /security-review in Copilot SDK sessions also runs a purpose-built secret detection model alongside the existing analysis to find unstructured credentials, such as passwords without a recognizable token format.

progressUpdatesPrompt.title: Progress Updates Prompt
progressUpdatesPrompt.description: When enabled, Copilot SDK sessions running a GPT model or Auto are asked to send brief user-visible progress updates before and between tool calls.

progressUpdatesPromptDefaultControlled.title: Progress Updates Prompt Default Control
progressUpdatesPromptDefaultControlled.description: Whether the workbench progress updates prompt setting has no explicit override. Used only to gate setting experiment telemetry.

localMemory.title: Local Copilot Memory
localMemory.description: When enabled, Copilot SDK sessions store memories in the repository's .github/copilot-memories.jsonl file instead of GitHub's cloud memory service. Requires a GitHub-hosted repository; GitHub Copilot Memory settings and policies don't apply.

memoryMode.title: Copilot Memory Placement
memoryMode.description: Where Copilot SDK sessions place retrieved Copilot Memory: in the system prompt, or in generated user messages.

memoryModeDefaultControlled.title: Copilot Memory Placement Default Control
memoryModeDefaultControlled.description: Whether the workbench Copilot Memory placement setting has no explicit override. Used only to gate setting experiment telemetry.

skillCharBudget.title: Skill Character Budget
skillCharBudget.description: Maximum number of characters available for skill descriptions in the Copilot SDK system message.

autoModeTierOverride.title: Auto Optimize for Override
autoModeTierOverride.description: Overrides Auto's "Optimize for" preference. Accepts efficiency, balance, or intelligence. Applied when a session is created or resumed and when its model changes. Empty or unsupported values use the picker or service defaults.

modelCapabilityOverrides.title: Model Capability Overrides
modelCapabilityOverrides.description: Per-model overrides for Copilot SDK sessions. Use `*` to match every model. Intended for experimentation.

additionalProperties.title: Capability Override
additionalProperties.description: A single capability override. The property key is the model id.

family.title: Family
family.description: Route the model to another family's tuned system prompt and tool profile (e.g. `claude-opus-4.8`). The model id sent to the runtime is unaffected, so the session still runs on the selected model.

reasoningEffort.title: Reasoning Effort
reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort for sessions on this model; overrides the model picker's effort level. Unrecognized values are ignored.

availableTools.title: Available Tools
availableTools.description: When set, only matching tools are available to sessions on this model. Patterns: bare tool names, `builtin:*` or `builtin:<name>` (Copilot runtime tools), `mcp:*` or `mcp:<name>` (MCP server tools), and `custom:*` or `custom:<name>` (every tool VS Code registers with the SDK, including the agent host's own terminal tools); a bare `*` expands to all three sources. Applied when the session launches or resumes.

excludedTools.title: Excluded Tools
excludedTools.description: Tools disabled for sessions on this model; same pattern syntax as `availableTools` and takes precedence over it. Note that `custom:*` and a bare `*` also disable the agent host's own terminal tools registered with the SDK. Applied when the session launches or resumes.

modelCapabilities.title: Model Capabilities
modelCapabilities.description: Per-property model capability overrides passed through to the Copilot SDK's `modelCapabilities` session field (e.g. `{ "supports": { "vision": false }, "limits": { "max_context_window_tokens": 64000 } }`), deep-merged over the runtime's resolved defaults for this model. Applied when the session launches or resumes.

promptOverrideString.title: Prompt Override String
promptOverrideString.description: Inline YAML that overrides the system prompt and/or SDK tool descriptions for sessions on this model. Takes precedence over `promptOverrideFile`.

promptOverrideFile.title: Prompt Override File
promptOverrideFile.description: Path to a YAML file that overrides the system prompt and/or SDK tool descriptions for sessions on this model. Ignored when `promptOverrideString` is also set.

localModelEnabled.title: On-Device Models
localModelEnabled.description: When enabled, Copilot SDK sessions can download and run on-device models. Changing this setting restarts the Copilot SDK client after active turns finish.

localModelUseInAuto.title: Use On-Device Model in Auto
localModelUseInAuto.description: When enabled, Auto can route turns to the active on-device model, with cloud fallback. Local models may not use the same safety filters as GitHub Copilot-provided models and may be more susceptible to malicious instructions, especially when actions are automatically approved.

localModelLlamaServerPath.title: llama-server Path
localModelLlamaServerPath.description: Absolute path to the llama-server executable that serves on-device models. VS Code doesn't install llama.cpp.

localModelAccountGate.title: On-Device Models Allowed for Account
localModelAccountGate.description: Whether the signed-in account allows on-device models. Set by the client.

includeCoAuthoredBy.title: Include Co-authored-by Trailer
includeCoAuthoredBy.description: When enabled, Copilot SDK sessions add a `Co-authored-by` trailer to the commits they create. Applied when a session starts or resumes.

shellAuthentication.title: Shell Authentication Prompts
shellAuthentication.description: When enabled, Copilot SDK sessions ask in chat for the passwords, passphrases, and confirmations that `sudo -A`, `ssh`, and `git` request, and send the answer only to that program. Applied when a session starts or resumes.

automationsEnabled.title: Automations
automationsEnabled.description: Whether this Agent Host may run automations.

codex.personality.title: Personality
codex.personality.description: Controls the default communication style for Codex. Default leaves personality unset in config.toml.

codex.autoReviewPolicy.title: Auto-review policy
codex.autoReviewPolicy.description: Updates auto_review.policy in config.toml. Leave empty to remove the auto_review section.

vscode.agentCustomizationSettings.title: Codex
vscode.agentCustomizationSettings.description: Configure Codex defaults stored in config.toml. Project and managed configuration can override these user values.

configurationFile.title: Advanced configuration
configurationFile.description: Open the Codex configuration file to customize additional agent behavior.
